u8-l1#firma.picture: A busy morning at Tomáš's company: on every floor of the building people are at work, in offices, in a meeting, at a training session and in the canteen. At the entrance, Tomáš waves to the receptionist.

u8-l1#oddelenie.picture: The technical department of Tomáš's company: Tomáš and two colleagues work at their screens while an IT technician carries a new computer through the room.

u8-l1#zamestnanec-zamestnankyna.picture: An after-work party at Tomáš's company: employees, men and women, chat in small groups round a table of snacks and drinks; Tomáš talks with a woman colleague in a blazer.

u8-l1#porada.picture: A team meeting at Tomáš's company: Tomáš and four colleagues sit round a table with their manager, talking things over.

u8-l1#stretnutie.picture: A business lunch: Tomáš and a client in a suit sit across a restaurant table from each other, talking over their plates.

u8-l1#staz.picture: At her dorm desk, Emma scrolls through job ads on her laptop and circles one in a printed list, a mug of tea beside her.

u8-l1#zivotopis.picture: Emma's CV lies finished on her desk, one page with a small photo of her in the corner; she signs it with a flourish.

u8-l1#pohovor.picture: A job interview in a small office at Tomáš's company: Emma, in a smart blazer, sits upright across the desk from the HR manager, who reads her CV through her glasses.

u8-l2#cez-vikend.picture: A sunny Saturday: Emma, Lucia and Tomáš hike up a forest path in the hills above Bratislava with backpacks, Lucia leading the way.

u8-l2#v-lete.picture: Summer: Emma and Lucia cycle along a path through green rolling hills under a hot sun.

u8-l2#v-zime.picture: Winter: the same rolling hills under deep snow; Emma and Lucia, in woolly hats and scarves, trudge along the path.

u8-rok#jar-a-jesen.picture: Two halves, the same rolling hills as in the summer and winter pictures, with Emma and Lucia on the path. Left, spring: fresh green fields and trees in white blossom, the two in light jackets. Right, autumn: golden-brown fields and red and yellow trees, the two in scarves, kicking through fallen leaves.

u8-rok#minuta-a-sekunda.picture: On the university running track, Lucia holds up a stopwatch, her eyes on the ticking seconds, as Tomáš sprints the last metres of his lap.
